root_cause: Three migrations (20261025195609, 20261026115246, 20261026115659) were applied to the production project but their source files only existed on the unmerged recovery branch of PR #4967. Supabase Preview on main therefore reported remote versions not found locally, which also blocked the automatic edge-function deploy of the Supabase integration.
prevention: The three source files are mirrored on main byte-for-byte with the remote statements. A brain test asserts their presence and non-destructive content. No new DDL is executed; the files are already applied remotely.

evidence.runtime_status: unverified until Supabase Preview on main is green and the next merged edge-function change deploys through the integration

limitations: PR #4967 keeps its own copies; a later rebase of that PR must not duplicate these versions
